title: Meal photo scan speed + trust UX
goal: Fix tester complaint: photo analysis very slow and accuracy doubted
steps: Compress/resize image to max 1024px longest side before upload
Add staged progress UI during analysis: 'بنحلل الطبق… بنقدّر المكونات… بنحسب الزيت…'
Result screen always shows ≈ estimate + visible oil/portion sliders (calibration IS the UI)
Queue scan when offline: 'هنحسبها أول ما النت يرجع'
Log scan duration; target under 8 seconds on 4G
acceptance: P50 scan latency under 8s on average Egyptian 4G (measure via existing bench tooling)
No raw-precision calorie numbers anywhere in result UI
